diagnosis.cause: The D1prime workflow scans its own complete source text for forbidden credential/request substrings. Those exact substrings occur inside the embedded Python checker itself, so the checker flags its own detection code even though no credential binding or semantic Copilot invocation exists in the workflow execution surface.

repair_boundary.allowed: Replace the two self-referential substring predicates with a non-self-matching structural/whitelist check of executable Copilot command surfaces; refresh only identities transitively changed by that workflow byte change.
forbidden: Copilot semantic request before repaired D1prime identity PASS
